Add navigation, a scale bar and a layer switch to a MapLibre GL map

Source: R/gq_mapgl_controls.R
gq_mapgl_controls.Rd

The last call of a gq web map. The layer switch lists the layers by the names a reader sees, so a layer's id can stay short. The four corners each get one element: legends top left (from gq_mapgl_layer()), the switch at position, navigation bottom right and the scale bar bottom left.

Usage

gq_mapgl_controls(
  map,
  layers = NULL,
  position = "top-right",
  navigation = TRUE,
  scale = TRUE
)

Arguments

map

A map from gq_mapgl_basemap().

layers

The layers to switch: a named character vector, label = layer id (c(Habitat = "rules")), or unnamed ids, which are shown as they are. NULL switches every layer on the map. character(0) adds no switch.

position

The switch's corner.

navigation

Add zoom and compass buttons.

scale

Add a scale bar.

Value

map, with the controls added.

See also

gq_mapgl_layer()

Examples

obs <- neexdzii_fish_obs
m <- gq_mapgl_basemap(neexdzii_wsd, "positron") |>
  gq_mapgl_layer("co", obs[obs$species_code == "CO", "species_code"],
                 color = "#FF7F00", legend_title = "Coho") |>
  gq_mapgl_layer("rb", obs[obs$species_code == "RB", "species_code"],
                 color = "#377EB8", legend_title = "Rainbow trout") |>
  gq_mapgl_controls(c(Coho = "co", "Rainbow trout" = "rb"))
m$x$layers_control$layers
#>          Coho Rainbow trout 
#>          "co"          "rb"
